modcombiner: Merge other mods' sounds into your compile - nothing of yours is removed.
replacesounds: Replace any game sound directly by its file - no soundevents touched. Browse a category, preview, then drop in your audio.
effects: Recolor any particle effect - hero abilities, item effects, and more. Preview the recolor live, then compile to apply.
particleguide: Every particle function in the game with what it does and the values Valve actually uses - the docs the particle editor never had.
posters: Replace the world's posters, signs, ghost signs, and graffiti with your own images - drop a PNG onto a region and compile.
animatedart: Play GIFs and videos on in-world paintings and signs - fill as many surfaces as you like. Technique by goldenboy44, used with permission.
menuart: Replace the game's screen art - the play-mode cards, their hero portraits, or any menu image by path.
jumpscares: Random jumpscares while you play + videos when you die - your MoonahMasterUI mod, configured here and rebuilt on compile.
uimaster: Edit the game's UI files directly - decompiled to source, compiled back into your mod. Very experimental.
packbuilder: Organize the pack into named modules - the future split points for standalone releases. Compiling still builds everything together.
modelswap: Put your own model on a hero or on the game's objects - the urn, crates, soul containers, map props. The original's animations, physics and setup stay; your build ships with the normal compile.
unsorted: Everything that doesn't have a home tab yet, plus one search box over every sound event in the game.
soundTabs: Most used shows the curated and pinned sounds. Switch to All to browse every sound event this tab covers and pin the ones you reach for.
